name: jobbridge
description: A Slack agent that helps job seekers find jobs, understand companies, and prepare to apply — powered by Hybrid RAG + MCP + Apify.

scripts.rag: cd rag && UVICORN_BIN=uvicorn; if [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then UVICORN_BIN=.venv/bin/uvicorn; fi; "$UVICORN_BIN" api.server:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.rag:prod: cd rag && UVICORN_BIN=uvicorn; if [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then UVICORN_BIN=.venv/bin/uvicorn; fi; "$UVICORN_BIN" api.server:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${RAG_PORT:-8000} --workers ${RAG_WORKERS:-1}
scripts.rag:ingest: cd rag && PYTHON_BIN=python3; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PYTHON_BIN=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PYTHON_BIN" scripts/ingest_docs.py
scripts.rag:verify-staging: cd rag && PYTHON_BIN=python3; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PYTHON_BIN=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PYTHON_BIN" scripts/verify_staging.py
scripts.test:rag: cd rag && PYTHON_BIN=python3; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PYTHON_BIN=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PYTHON_BIN" tests/test_rrf.py && "$PYTHON_BIN" tests/test_chunker.py && "$PYTHON_BIN" tests/test_metrics.py
